.. change::
    :tags: orm, feature
    :tickets: 6084

    The :paramref:`_orm.Mapper.version_id_col` mapper argument now accepts a
    string mapped-attribute name, consistent with ``polymorphic_on`` and the
    explicit ``primary_key`` mapper argument.  The name is resolved only after
    mapper properties have been configured, so it also works with mappings
    where the Python attribute and database column names differ.
